title: Architecture: Serialization, Reactive Props, and Reactive Output
text: shiny.mantine architecturally inspired Appsilon’s shiny.react — general idea serializing props JSON, syncing input values via Shiny.setInputValue(), loading assets htmlDependency . reuse shiny.react’s compiled JavaScript runtime React copy. reason version conflict: Mantine v9 requires React >= 19.2, shiny.react shares single React 18.3.1 copy across every package uses externals mechanism. Mounting two different React copies page causes hook-dispatcher conflicts (“Invalid hook call”) — see Appsilon/shiny.react#87. shiny.mantine bundles React 19 / ReactDOM 19 copy inside inst/www/mantine.js, completely independent shiny.react’s runtime, small mount input-sync layer reimplementing concepts.

title: Architecture: Serialization, Reactive Props, and Reactive Output
text: Every component wrapper thin call one two internal helpers R/mantine-element.R: ultimately call mantineElement(), builds plain, serializable tree — list(type = "element", name = <string>, props = <list>) — tagged S3 class mantine_element: prop value recursively normalized toMantineData() one small set tagged shapes (raw, array, object, element, html) JS side’s buildElement()/buildProps() (js/src/serialization.js) knows turn back real React elements plain JS values: Nesting works exactly like htmltools: unnamed argument becomes part element’s children, mantine_element passed argument serialized recursively (’s Text("Hello") ends nested inside Card()’s children prop ). MantineProvider() one function doesn’t return plain mantine_element — calls renderMantineRoot(), serializes tree JSON wraps self-mounting htmltools fragment (<div> holding JSON plus <script> calls window.jsmodule['@/shiny.mantine'].mount()). MantineProvider() must always outermost call: ’s one actually produces mountable HTML output.

title: Architecture: Serialization, Reactive Props, and Reactive Output
text: Dedicated update*() functions like updateMantineTextInput() ever touch one thing: input’s value. plenty props aren’t “value” sense — Modal’s opened, Stepper’s active, Badge’s color. , ’s single generic mechanism: updateMantineProps(). sends list(id = <mantineId>, props = list(...)) shinyMantineUpdateProps custom message. JS side, withReactiveProps() — small HOC wrapping every component accepts mantineId prop — keeps local “patch” object React state per mounted mantineId, merges incoming props , triggering re-render: makes Modal(mantineId = "my_modal", ...) + updateMantineProps(session, "my_modal", opened = TRUE) work, ’s reused throughout package: Collapse’s opened, Stepper’s active, component’s disabled/color/label can changed way without rebuilding tree. every component supports mantineId — ones explicitly wrapped withReactiveProps() js/src/index.js, practice almost everything registry (including every component automated generator produces, see ).
code: updateMantineProps #> function (session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain(), mantineId,  #>     ...)  #> { #>     session$sendCustomMessage("shinyMantineUpdateProps", list(id = session$ns(mantineId),  #>         props = list(...))) #> } #> <bytecode: 0x55ec8a592940> #> <environment: namespace:shiny.mantine> function withReactiveProps(Component) {   return function Wrapped({ mantineId, ...props }) {     const [patch, setPatch] = useState({});     useEffect(() => {       if (!mantineId) return undefined;       propUpdateHandlers[mantineId] = (newProps) => setPatch((prev) => ({ ...prev, ...newProps }));       return () => { delete propUpdateHandlers[mantineId]; };     }, [mantineId]);     return React.createElement(Component, { ...props, ...patch });   }; } # ui: Modal(mantineId = "confirm", inputId = "confirm_state", title = "Confirm", Text("Are you sure?"))  # server: observeEvent(input$open_btn, {   updateMantineProps(session, "confirm", opened = TRUE) })

title: Architecture: Serialization, Reactive Props, and Reactive Output
text: MantineProvider() mounts whole tree , statically, page load. built-way make reactively rebuild — unlike uiOutput()/renderUI() regular HTML. mantineOutput()/renderMantine() close gap: mantineOutput() mounts independent React root via generic Shiny output binding registered js/src/index.js. renderUI(), every re-evaluation expression rebuilds whole sub-tree, uncontrolled local state inside (e.g. text typed TextInput stable inputId) can lost updates. want Mantine’s theme/color-scheme inside reactive output , can wrap content nested MantineProvider() — normally impossible nest usefully (just serialize inert HTML string, since embedded mount <script> never execute injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML), toMantineData() special-cases : renderMantineRoot() attaches pre-serialization element R attribute (mantine_root), toMantineData() checks recovers falling back generic HTML serialization:
code: # ui: mantineOutput("summary")  # server: output$summary <- renderMantine({   Card(withBorder = TRUE, Text(paste("Total:", sum(input$values)))) }) # renderMantineRoot()/toMantineData() are internal (not exported), since # ordinary usage never needs to call them directly. nested <- shiny.mantine:::renderMantineRoot(Stack(Text("nested"))) recovered <- shiny.mantine:::toMantineData(nested) str(recovered, max.level = 1) #> List of 3 #>  $ type : chr "element" #>  $ name : chr "Stack" #>  $ props:List of 1

title: Core: Combobox
text: https://mantine.dev/core/combobox/ — reach Select()/MultiSelect()/Autocomplete()/TagsInput()/ ComboboxPopover() don’t fit (e.g. options need fully custom icons/layout beyond renderOption-style composition covers). real Mantine Combobox driven live useCombobox() store (JS object methods); Combobox() creates owns store internally, R API stays declarative: ComboboxTarget()’s single child (e.g. Button()) toggles dropdown click automatically. Selecting ComboboxOption() sends value input[[inputId]] (event, like actionButton()) closes dropdown; highlighting current selection (active = TRUE) responsibility, Mantine’s controlled examples. ComboboxSearch() wired like text input (input[[inputId]] every keystroke) — pair renderMantine()/mantineOutput() re-render ComboboxOptions() server-side user types, since R-side filter function can’t cross bridge way Mantine’s filter prop .
code: Combobox(   inputId = "fruit",   ComboboxTarget(Button("Pick a fruit", variant = "default")),   ComboboxDropdown(     ComboboxOptions(       ComboboxOption(value = "apple", "🍎 Apple"),       ComboboxOption(value = "banana", "🍌 Banana")     )   ) )  # server: observeEvent(input$fruit, {   message("Picked: ", input$fruit) })

code: FocusTrap(   active = TRUE,   Stack(     FocusTrapInitialFocus(), # marks which element should receive focus first     TextInput(inputId = "first_field", label = "Focused first"),     TextInput(inputId = "second_field", label = "Second field")   ) ) RemoveScroll(enabled = TRUE, Paper(withBorder = TRUE, p = "md", Text("Page behind this can't be scrolled while enabled.")))

title: Core: Miscellaneous
text: MantineProvider() — required, always outermost, see vignette("getting-started") — aside, two core-level providers: DirectionProvider() sets "ltr"/"rtl" reading direction everything nested inside: MantineThemeProvider(theme = list(...)) updates theme object exposed via Mantine’s useMantineTheme() hook custom code explicitly reads . restyle standard components (Button(), Badge(), …): get colors CSS variables outermost MantineProvider() injects , nesting MantineThemeProvider() different primaryColor change nested Button()’s color: need visually different theme part page, currently requires second, independent MantineProvider() (color-scheme-sync caveat — see README’s “Known limitations”).
code: MantineProvider(DirectionProvider(dir = "rtl"), Text("Right-to-left content")) Group(   Button("Outside the provider", inputId = "btn_a"),   MantineThemeProvider(theme = list(primaryColor = "red"), Button("Inside (still the same color)", inputId = "btn_b")) )

title: Core: Miscellaneous
text: handful @mantine/core/@mantine/dates exports R wrapper, concrete architectural reason rather “gotten yet” (every mantine.dev page checked package’s exports — see vignette("core-combobox") far pragmatic Combobox() wrapper actually goes, bullets ): FloatingIndicator (lower-level FloatingArrow) — need literal DOM element ref (target/parent) recalculated every state change, plain, JSON-serializable R value. Mantine’s styled components (SegmentedControl(), Tabs(), …) already provide equivalent animated-indicator effect box without . SSR/Next.js-specific helpers (ColorSchemeScript, HeadlessMantineProvider, InlineStyles) — applicable Shiny’s client-side-mount architecture. Calendar (@mantine/dates) sub-parts (Month, Day, WeekdaysRow, …) — low-level primitive DatePicker()/ DatePickerInput()/MonthPicker()/YearPicker() built ; customization beyond offer goes function-based getDayProps callback, can’t cross R/JSON bridge. RichTextEditor’s ColorPicker/Color/UnsetColor controls — need Tiptap Color/TextStyle extensions plus swatches configuration wired ; scope package’s intentionally reduced-scope editor (see vignette("core-typography") — tables, images, collaborative editing either).

text: https://mantine.dev/core/modal/ — centered dialog dimmed backdrop. one Modal() open needs ModalStack() instead independent ones (don’t otherwise coordinate z-index/focus trapping): full control internal layout, use compound form — ModalRoot() + ModalOverlay()/ModalContent()/ModalHeader()/ ModalTitle()/ModalCloseButton()/ModalBody() — opens/closes exactly like Modal() (can join ModalStack() ):
code: Stack(   Button("Open", inputId = "open_btn"),   Modal(     mantineId = "demo_modal", inputId = "modal_state", title = "Demo",     Text("Are you sure you want to continue?"),     Button("Confirm", inputId = "confirm_btn")   ) )  # server: observeEvent(input$open_btn, {   updateMantineProps(session, "demo_modal", opened = TRUE) }) ModalStack(   mantineId = "delete_stack",   Modal("delete_page", inputId = "delete_page_state", title = "Delete this page?",     Button("Continue", inputId = "go_to_confirm")   ),   Modal("confirm_delete", title = "Are you really sure?",     Button("Yes, delete", inputId = "confirm_delete_btn", color = "red")   ) ) ModalRoot(   "custom_modal", inputId = "custom_modal_state",   ModalOverlay(),   ModalContent(     ModalHeader(ModalTitle("Custom layout"), ModalCloseButton()),     ModalBody(Text("Modal content"))   ) )

text: https://mantine.dev/core/floating-window/ — draggable floating panel positioned anywhere viewport user; initialPosition sets starts (plain list(top=, left=)/list(bottom=, right=) data — window’s live position dragged isn’t readable/settable server, since needs client-side ref). parent needs position: relative (similar) floating window positioned . Add dimensions make resizable (list(initialWidth=, minWidth=, maxWidth=, initialHeight=, minHeight=, maxHeight=)) together FloatingWindowResizeHandle() child, typically pinned corner via style: Set inputId react resizing server-side (added Mantine 9.5.1): input[[inputId]] holds current list(width=, height=) every drag-resize, input[[paste0(inputId, "_resize_start")]]/ input[[paste0(inputId, "_resize_end")]] fire events drag-resize begins/ends (fired keyboard resizing via handle). window’s position still reported (see ).

title: Getting Started with shiny.mantine
text: Every shiny.mantine UI needs exactly one MantineProvider() wrapping everything — supplies theme color-scheme context every component depends : things notice: TextInput(inputId = "name", ...) behaves exactly like shiny::textInput(): input$name updates every keystroke. Button(..., inputId = "greet_btn") behaves like shiny::actionButton(): input$greet_btn click counter. Mixing native Shiny output (textOutput()) inside shiny.mantine component (Text()) works fine — ’s reverse (nesting native Shiny binding direct structural child MantineProvider()’s markup) doesn’t, since content injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML Shiny won’t re-scan bindings. Keep native Shiny inputs/outputs either fully outside MantineProvider(), nested inside shiny.mantine component like Text()/Card() (shown ), siblings passed directly MantineProvider()’s .... Everything render normal, intended size box, regardless whether UI uses fluidPage() (loads Shiny’s bundled Bootstrap 3 CSS, setting page’s root font-size 10px instead browser’s 16px default) plain tagList() (doesn’t). MantineProvider() measures real root font-size mount time compensates automatically either way — see “Font-size scaling Shiny’s Bootstrap CSS” README — ’s worth knowing ever pass theme explicit scale, set fixShinyFontScale = FALSE.
code: library(shiny) library(shiny.mantine)  ui <- fluidPage(   MantineProvider(     Stack(       Title("Hello, Mantine"),       TextInput(inputId = "name", label = "Your name", placeholder = "Ada Lovelace"),       Button("Greet me", inputId = "greet_btn"),       Text(textOutput("greeting"))     )   ) )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   output$greeting <- renderText({     req(input$greet_btn > 0)     paste("Hello,", input$name %||% "stranger", "!")   }) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: Satellite Packages
text: Chart components accept data either data.frame (one row per point/category — converted automatically list rows) already-prepared list: BarChart()/AreaChart()/RadarChart()/CompositeChart() share LineChart()’s data/series shape; DonutChart()/FunnelChart() share PieChart()’s name/value/color shape. RadialBarChart()/ BubbleChart() take data/dataKey without series. Sparkline() takes plain numeric vector instead data.frame. BarsList() takes data.frame/list rows name/value columns, rendering row horizontal bar value (axes) — good compact top-N/leaderboard displays. SunburstChart() (added Mantine 9.5) takes nested list like Treemap() (list(name=, value=, color=, children=...)) plots concentric rings. BulletChart() (also added 9.5) compact KPI chart: actual value plotted optional target ranges data.frame/list rows (value = range’s upper bound, color, optional label) shown background bands. ScatterChart(), Treemap(), Heatmap(), SankeyChart() nested data shapes (documented function’s ?help page) rather one flat table, since charts aren’t naturally one-row-per-point. Charts unbounded container (e.g. plain Stack() fixed height, ) need explicit h (height) — Recharts, every Mantine chart built , silently renders nothing can’t resolve definite pixel height . LineChart()/BarChart()/PieChart()/ etc. happen ship sensible default; several newer chart types (RadarChart(), RadialBarChart(), BubbleChart(), CompositeChart(), ScatterChart(), SunburstChart()) , pass h = 250 (similar) explicitly one renders blank. Since Mantine 9.5, LineChart()/BarChart()/AreaChart()/ CompositeChart()/ScatterChart()/BubbleChart()/PieChart()/ DonutChart()/RadarChart()/RadialBarChart()/FunnelChart() support accessibilityLayer (keyboard navigation, TRUE default) LineChart()/BarChart()/AreaChart()/CompositeChart() support withBrush = TRUE show range-selector brush chart — plain boolean props, passed like .

title: Satellite Packages
text: Calendar/scheduling views: DayView(), WeekView(), MonthView(), YearView(), AgendaView() (scrollable event list fixed date range), MobileMonthView() (touch-optimized), resource-grouped ResourcesDayView()/ResourcesWeekView()/ResourcesMonthView() (events grouped rows/columns e.g. meeting room staff member), Schedule() (behind one component day/week/month/year switcher). Events data.frame/list rows id, title, start, end, optionally color/resourceId columns — start/end accept "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" strings R Date/POSIXct values, converted automatically. Every view reports currently displayed date input[[inputId]] (primary value, like every stateful input package); handful interactions reported suffixed input ids — input[[paste0(inputId, "_event_click")]] (clicked event’s id), input[[paste0(inputId, "_slot_click")]], input[[paste0(inputId, "_slot_select")]] (drag--select range, needs withDragSlotSelect = TRUE), input[[paste0(inputId, "_event_drop")]]/input[[paste0(inputId, "_event_resize")]] (needs withEventsDragAndDrop/withEventResize = TRUE) — see ?ScheduleViews full list. Update date/events (prop) server updateMantineProps() (needs mantineId). ResourcesDayView()/ResourcesWeekView()/ResourcesMonthView() also take resources data.frame/list (id/label columns), event’s resourceId match one . intervalMinutes prop (default 60) accepts values dividing evenly hour (e.g. 15, 30) whole numbers hours (e.g. 120, 240) — values 60 widen column span several hours instead subdividing within hour, useful fit whole day view compactly: Render-prop customization (renderEvent, renderEventBody, renderResourceLabel, custom per-event drag/resize predicates, …) JS-callback-based exposed — every event draggable/resizable whenever matching * flag set, default rendering used throughout (trade-already made Combobox()/ TableOfContents()/OverflowList(); see vignette("core-misc")).

title: shiny.mantine 0.2.0
text: Initial public release. Updated Mantine 9.5.1. FloatingWindow() gained optional inputId: set, resizing (via FloatingWindowResizeHandle()) reports new size input[[inputId]] (list(width=, height=)) fires input[[paste0(inputId, "_resize_start")]]/"_resize_end" events — previously component way react resizing server-side. Every 9.5.1 change (ColorInput(fullWidth=), PasswordInput(visibilityToggleFocusable=), Cascader(safeAreaPolygon=), ScatterChart’s second Y axis via withRightYAxis/rightYAxisProps/ per-series yAxisId, YearView(withWeekendDays=), ResourcesMonthView’s new withEventResize support) already worked code changes, since components forward arbitrary props/data unmodified. YearView’s new renderDay prop JS render function exposed, consistent every render* prop package. Updated Mantine 9.5.0. New components: Combobox() (plus compound sub-parts: ComboboxTarget(), ComboboxDropdown(), ComboboxOptions(), ComboboxOption(), ComboboxSearch(), …) — headless dropdown primitive Select()/MultiSelect()/Autocomplete()/ TagsInput() built top , now wrapped internally owning Mantine’s useCombobox() store R API stays fully declarative; ComboboxPopover()/ComboboxPopoverTarget(); OverflowList(); TableOfContents(); Cascader() (hierarchical cascading-column selection, added Mantine 9.5); FloatingWindowResizeHandle() (added 9.5); MonthPicker()/YearPicker() (always-visible inline counterparts MonthPickerInput()/YearPickerInput()); TimeValue(); BarsList(); SunburstChart()/BulletChart() (added 9.5); DropzoneFullScreen() (captures drops anywhere browser window, just fixed area). Added full wrapper @mantine/schedule satellite package (package’s 11th): DayView(), WeekView(), MonthView(), YearView(), AgendaView(), MobileMonthView(), resource-grouped ResourcesDayView()/ResourcesWeekView()/ResourcesMonthView() (including intervalMinutes support multi-hour columns, e.g. intervalMinutes = 240), Schedule() (unified view day/week/month/year switcher). Events/resources data.frames (lists rows) automatic Date/POSIXct conversion start/end; drag--drop resize (withEventsDragAndDrop/ withEventResize) update display immediately report change Shiny suffixed input id, pattern already used SortableList()/SortableTable(). See vignette("satellite-packages"). Fixed RichTextEditor()’s Highlight toolbar button dead -op (Tiptap extension never registered); added Subscript/ Superscript/TaskList support new controls prop customize/trim toolbar layout. Fixed latent bug MultiSelect()/TagsInput()/CheckboxGroup()/ SwitchGroup() (update*() counterparts) crash given single-item value (e.g. c("onlyone")): jsonlite’s auto_unbox collapses length-1 vector bare JSON scalar instead 1-element array, calls .map() value unconditionally JS side. Fixed via new internal ensureArray() helper, also used Cascader()’s path value. Every mantine.dev page re-audited package’s exports 9.5.0 release; remaining gaps Calendar() FloatingIndicator() (need live DOM ref function-callback prop can’t cross R/JSON bridge) — see vignette("core-misc")’s “Intentionally scope” section. 10 Mantine satellite packages (dates, notifications, modals, spotlight, charts, code-highlight, nprogress, tiptap, dropzone, carousel) now code-split chunk (inst/www/<family>.mantine.js), dynamically fetched (JS + CSS) first time component family actually mounts, instead bundled unconditionally inst/www/mantine.js. bare MantineProvider() app now loads ~1.1 MiB JS single @mantine/core stylesheet instead ~2.3 MiB 11 stylesheets (10 satellite packages + core) regardless components actually uses. See js/src/satellites/*.js, js/src/lazy.js, updated “Known limitations” section README. R wrappers full @mantine/core component set (layout, typography, navigation, inputs, overlays, data display) plus ten satellite packages: dates, notifications, modals, spotlight, charts, code-highlight, nprogress, tiptap, dropzone, carousel. client-side page router (Pages()/Page()). generic reactive-props update channel (updateMantineProps()) updating component prop server, just input’s value. renderUI()-equivalent reactive output Mantine content (mantineOutput()/renderMantine()). ModalStack()/DrawerStack() — coordinated stacks Modal()/ Drawer()s (layered z-index, focus trapping, closeAll()), opened closed updateMantineProps() calls standalone one. bundled React 19 runtime, independent shiny.react’s shared React 18 runtime, required compatibility Mantine v9. runnable demo app per ui.mantine.dev category inst/examples/. Compound/composable forms Modal()/Drawer()/Pagination()/ Spotlight() fully custom layouts: ModalRoot() + ModalOverlay()/ ModalContent()/ModalHeader()/ModalTitle()/ModalCloseButton()/ ModalBody() (Drawer*/Pagination*/Spotlight* equivalents). HueSlider()/AlphaSlider()/AngleSlider() — standalone versions ColorPicker()’s channel sliders, plus circular angle dial. Input/InputBase/InputWrapper/InputLabel/InputDescription/ InputError/InputPlaceholder primitives, FocusTrap()/ RemoveScroll(), MantineThemeProvider(), RadioIndicator()/ CheckboxIndicator(), small standalone pieces Mantine renders internally (CheckIcon(), CloseIcon(), AccordionChevron(), RadioIcon(), ActionIconGroupSection(), ButtonGroupSection()). Every page https://mantine.dev/core/ audited package’s exports (comparing package’s exports every @mantine/core runtime export, cross-checked Mantine’s documented page list) close last three genuinely missing components — Scroller() (horizontally-scrollable container arrow controls), FloatingWindow() (draggable floating panel), PillsInput()/PillsInputField() (multi-value input box MultiSelect()/TagsInput() use internally) — plus handful small sub-parts rounding already-covered families: InputClearButton(), InputSuccess(), PaginationControl(), PaginationLabel(), FocusTrapInitialFocus(). Vignettes restructured around https://mantine.dev/core/’s category sidebar: single component-gallery vignette replaced ten core-* vignettes (core-layout, core-inputs, core-combobox, core-buttons, core-navigation, core-feedback, core-overlays, core-data-display, core-typography, core-misc), R rewrite corresponding mantine.dev/core page(s), plus new extras vignette group inputs, drag--drop reordering, button recipes don’t mantine.dev/core page. satellite-packages gained @mantine/dropzone/@mantine/carousel sections used live removed vignette.

title: shiny.mantine 0.2.0
text: Fixed echo/ping-pong feedback loop stateful inputs (TextInput()/Slider()/Switch()/…): server-pushed value via update*() longer re-reports back Shiny fresh user edit, previously caused erratic/flickering behavior two inputs kept sync pair observeEvent()s (e.g. NumberInput() mirrored Slider()). Fixed SplitButton()’s dropdown arrow rendering mismatched border-radius primary button. Fixed unreadable text dark mode inside fluidPage()/bootstrapPage() apps: Bootstrap 3’s body { color: #333333; } specificity , (loaded later) wins , Mantine’s body { color: var(--mantine-color-text); }, permanently pinning every Text/Title/Paper/Stepper label (anything inherits text color rather setting ) fixed dark gray never adapted dark mode — invisible light mode, unreadable dark-mode backgrounds. specific rule scoped .shiny-mantine-container/ .shiny-mantine-output now wins regardless stylesheet load order. Fixed Bootstrap 3 CSS leak (fluidPage()’s bundled input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] { margin: 4px 0 0 } rule) misaligning checked icon inside Checkbox()/Radio()/ Switch()/Chip()/CheckboxCard()/RadioCard() group items. Fixed @mantine/spotlight’s CSS silently dropped production bundle (package.json declares "sideEffects": false *.css exception, unlike @mantine/core, webpack’s tree-shaking removed “unused” stylesheet import) — made SpotlightActionsGroup()’s label never actually render.
